title: Senior Specialist - Data Engineering
description:
**Role description**

Key Responsibilities

Administer and maintain Snowflake environments across development testing and production

Manage users roles privileges and rolebased access control RBAC

Manage warehouses databases schemas storage and other Snowflake objects

Monitor warehouse utilization query performance resource consumption and platform health

Perform performance tuning and troubleshoot Snowflake platform and queryrelated issues

Implement and maintain security governance auditing and accesscontrol standards

Support data loading integration migration backuprecovery and operational activities

Configure and manage resource monitors and support costoptimization activities

Work with data engineering cloud security and application teams to resolve platform issues

Lead productionsupport activities incident resolution upgrades and administrative automation

Provide technical guidance and mentoring to team members

Required Skills

Strong handson experience in Snowflake Administration

Strong knowledge of Snowflake architecture virtual warehouses databases schemas and storage

Experience with RBAC user administration roles privileges and security

Good knowledge of SQL and query performance tuning

Experience with monitoring troubleshooting and costperformance optimization

Knowledge of Snowpipe stages streams tasks cloning Time Travel and data sharing

Exposure to cloud platforms such as Azure AWS or GCP

Experience with scriptingautomation and CICD is preferred

Strong troubleshooting stakeholder management and technical leadership skills

Preferred Skills

Snowflake certification would be an advantage

Knowledge of enterprise data warehousing and ETLELT concepts

Exposure to tools such as DBT ADF Informatica or similar data integration platforms

Understanding of data security and governance practices

 **Skills**

**Mandatory Skills :** Snowflake Administration

title: Senior Specialist - System Management
description:
**Role description**

Job Summary

Seeking a Senior Specialist with 7 to 11 years of experience in DB2DB Administration and a strong background in application support

Job Description

Extensive experience in DB2 database administration including installation configuration performance tuning backup and recovery Proficient in managing database security user roles and access controls Handson experience with database monitoring tools and troubleshooting database issues Knowledge of Databricks as an added advantage to support data engineering and analytics workloads Ability to work in a dynamic environment supporting critical applications and ensuring high availability Experience collaborating with crossfunctional teams to deliver database solutions aligned with business needs Strong communication skills to interact effectively with clients and stakeholders Willingness to participate in both onsite and offshore support activities as required

Roles and Responsibilities

Provide expertlevel DB2 administration support including installation patching upgrades and configuration

Monitor database performance perform tuning and implement proactive measures to avoid downtime

Manage backup and recovery processes ensuring data integrity and availability

Handle database security management including user access roles and permissions

Collaborate with application support teams to troubleshoot and resolve databaserelated issues

Participate in client interactions to understand requirements and provide timely resolutions

Support implementation and maintenance of database solutions in production and nonproduction environments

Maintain documentation for database configurations processes and procedures

Stay updated with the latest DB2 features and best practices to improve operational efficiency

Support Databricks environment as a goodtohave skill to enhance data processing capabilities

Exhibit strong analytical skills and be a proactive team player contributing to continuous improvement initiatives

 **Skills**

**Mandatory Skills :** DB2-DB Administration  
**Good to Have Skills :** Databricks
